source.note: Chosen over example_sentences + entry_sentences: that pairing is 95% Tatoeba, largely traditional script, numbered pinyin only, and its links are substring matches rather than sense alignment. See the header of src/build/sentences.ts for the full comparison.

grading.definition: ZSG = the highest HSK 3.0 (2026) band of any content token after segmentation, clamped to 1-7. Computed from the canon word list plus the sentence text; no model, no copied grade.
grading.segmenter: Forward maximum matching over the canon's own simplified forms. Unmatched single characters take the lowest band of any canon word containing them.
grading.beyondHsk: A character no canon word contains is outside HSK 3.0; it forces the grade to 7 and is counted in beyondHskTokens.
grading.newWordCount: Per band prefix 1..7, the count of DISTINCT content token forms outside that prefix. A value of 1 is an i+1 sentence. Tokens outside HSK 3.0 count against every prefix, including 7.
grading.charLengthPercentile: Mid-rank percentile of the sentence's character count against every GRADED sentence of the same ZSG band — the full pool, not the shipped subset, which is chosen partly on length. Measured on this corpus rather than imported from the dialogue corpus.

sourceHskLevelAgreement.note: The source rows carry their own hskLevel. It is never trusted, only compared: this is a check on the computed grade, not an input to it.
